chunks: The sun was eclipsed during the time of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and he led them in prayer until a man could look at another man whose feet had become wet from his sweat.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, the celestial body undergoing eclipse
key_terms.انْكَسَفَتِ: was eclipsed; refers to the darkening of the sun
key_terms.عَهْدِ: the time or period of someone’s authority
key_terms.فَصَلَّى: then he performed salat; he led the prayer

ai.seo_question: How long did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام lead the people in the eclipse prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that a solar eclipse occurred during the time of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام and that he led the people in the eclipse prayer for a prolonged period. The report highlights the length and intensity of the salat, to the extent that the worshippers perspired heavily.
